newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Flour passes on 16,500 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Korea Flour passes on 16,500 tonnes of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Korea Flour Milling Corp passed on tenders on Thursday to buy 16,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat due to higher-than expected prices, traders said.
Shipment for the passed tenders was slated for July 5-August 5 from the Pacific Northwest to South Korea's western port of Mokpo, traders said.

The lowest bids were made by Japanese trading house Marubeni Corp at $165.72 a tonne C&F for 5,500 tonnes of soft white wheat (minimum protein 10.0 percent), at $163.51 a tonne C&F for 2,600 tonnes of soft white (maximum protein 9.5 percent), at $169.67 a tonne C&F for 4,000 tonnes of hard red winter (HRW), and at $182.25 a tonne C&F for 4,400 tonnes of dark northern spring (DNS) or northern spring (NS). --Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5651
